about: The Tauri app's last release (the bridge to the native app) and its updater key. Every stable native release carries this tag's latest.json, byte for byte, so Tauri installs that read releases/latest/download/latest.json update to the bridge, which then installs the native app. The repo variable TAURI_BRIDGE_TAG overrides tag. pubkey is plugins.updater.pubkey from desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json. See desktop-native/docs/INSTALLER.md, 'Publishing a release'.
